main_text.p: Quædam detrahunt: vt, Alméno, saltem: Purchè, modò: vt Purchè non végga, modò ne videam. Tánto tantùm: Solo, solùm.
Quædam reddunt causam: vt, Pecioché: enim: Accioché, vt: Concioſiacosache, enim, haud vterer.
Quædam concludunt: vt, Adúnque, ergo: Infomma, summa. Peró, poeticum, Percio, oratorium, propterea.
Quædam vsurpantur ornatus gratia vt, O'ra, Púre. Ben, &c.
main_text.head: DE INTERIECTIONE.
main_text.p: Gaudentis, o h. Ridentis, a h, a h. Admirantis, O, vh vh. Dolentis, a ih, Ah, Ohime. Desiderantis. Deh. Terrentis, Báco Báco, Oh Oh Dio.

page.notes: Printed text is in Latin with Italian words; the imprint line and the catchword area are not separately marked. Some letters in the scan are faint, notably in the Interiectio list, and the rendering of the long-s-like forms in the lower lines is uncertain.
